title: AD Certificate
description: Requests a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services.

AllowAllAppsAccess.title: Allow all apps access
AllowAllAppsAccess.description: If true, gives apps access to the private key.

CertServer.title: Certificate server
CertServer.description: The fully qualified host name of the CA.

CertTemplate.title: Certificate template
CertTemplate.description: The certificate template for your environment. The default user certificate value is User. The default computer certificate value is Machine.

CertificateAcquisitionMechanism.title: Certificate acquisition mechanism
CertificateAcquisitionMechanism.description: This value is most commonly RPC; if using web enrollment, use HTTP.

CertificateAuthority.title: Certificate authority
CertificateAuthority.description:
The name of the certificate authority (CA), which the device determines from the common name (CN) of the Active Directory entry. Valid values:

- CN=<your CA Name>
- CN=Certification Authorities
- CN=Public Key Services
- CN=Services
- CN=Configuration
- CN=<your base Domain Name>

CertificateRenewalTimeInterval.title: Certificate renewal time interval
CertificateRenewalTimeInterval.description: The number of days in advance of certificate expiration that the notification center notifies the user.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: A user-friendly description of the certification identity.

EnableAutoRenewal.title: Enable auto renewal
EnableAutoRenewal.description: If true, the certificate obtained with this payload attempts auto-renewal. Auto-renewal can only be used with device Active Directory certificate payloads.

KeyIsExtractable.title: Key is extractable
KeyIsExtractable.description: If true, the system allows exporting the private key.

Keysize.title: Key size
Keysize.description: The RSA key size for the certificate signing request (CSR).

PromptForCredentials.title: Prompt for credentials
PromptForCredentials.description: If true, the system prompts the user for credentials when is installs the profile. This key applies only to user certificates with the Manual Download profile delivery method. Omit this key for computer certificates.
